source_evidence: You can typically choose among several investment options with an ABLE account, which may include mutual funds and money market funds. You may also be able to allocate funds to FDIC insured savings or checking options.
answer: ABLE accounts may offer a mix of investment and cash-like choices. Depending on the account, options can include mutual funds or money market funds, as well as FDIC-insured savings or checking options. The available choices can vary, so check the options offered by the particular ABLE account.
